description: KL-38 is the Sub-Regional Transport Office (SRTO) located in Thodupuzha, Kerala. Established in 2006, it serves as a critical administrative hub for the Kerala Motor Vehicles Department in the Idukki district, managing vehicle registrations and licensing for the Thodupuzha belt. It helps decentralize the workload of the primary Idukki RTO (KL-06).
address: Prakash Building, Opposite Prakash Petrol Pump, Muvattupuzha Road, Thodupuzha, Kerala
